dslRule:
<!id: ccpactiongroup.constructor.arg.callhierarchy>
<!description: Add 'true' argument to CCPActionGroup constructor when instantiated in CallHierarchyViewPart to disable cut/paste/delete actions handled elsewhere.>
<!severity: HINT>

new org.eclipse.jdt.ui.actions.CCPActionGroup($arg$) :: inClass("org.eclipse.jdt.internal.ui.callhierarchy.CallHierarchyViewPart")
=> new org.eclipse.jdt.ui.actions.CCPActionGroup($arg$, true)
;;
summary: Adds a boolean literal 'true' as the second argument to the `CCPActionGroup` constructor when instantiated within the `CallHierarchyViewPart` class.
